content.title: City of Arvada Benefits Summary
content.summary: The City of Arvada offers a comprehensive benefits package for eligible full-time and part-time employees, which includes medical, dental, vision, and various insurance options, effective for the plan year 2026. Employees and their families can access benefits after one month of employment, with changes allowed only during specific life events or the annual Open Enrollment period. The medical plan is self-funded and administered by UMR, utilizing the United Healthcare network to minimize healthcare costs for employees.
content.body:
## Plan Year 2026

**We Dream Big & Deliver**

The City of Arvada values the contributions each employee makes on a daily basis to deliver “Superior Services to Enhance the Lives of Everyone in our Community”. The importance of being able to provide our employees and their families with quality benefits as part of their overall compensation package is a high priority. As a result, the City has developed a comprehensive benefits package that delivers quality and value while satisfying the diverse needs of our workforce. This summary is specifically designed to help you further understand the highlights of the benefit options offered to you by the City of Arvada for 2025. For full plan benefits, please refer to the Summary Plan Documents (SPDs).

### Eligibility

Full-Time and Part-Time benefited employees who work a minimum of 30 hours per week are eligible for benefits for themselves, their spouse, their same-sex spouse and their dependent children. New Hires are eligible for insurance the first day of the month following one full calendar month of employment following their hire date.

### Qualified Life Event

All benefit selections are binding except in the event you experience a “Qualified Life Event”. If one of these situations occurs, you have 30 days to notify Human Resources and complete the appropriate paperwork. If you do not make the change within the 30 days following the event, your next opportunity to make a change won’t occur until the plan’s next Open Enrollment period. Examples of status changes include:

- Marriage or divorce
- Birth or adoption of a child
- Child reaching the max age limit
- Death of a dependent
- Loss or gain of eligibility of insurance
- You lose coverage under your spouse's plan
- Unpaid leave of absence of employee or spouse
- Gaining access to state coverage under Medicaid, Medicare or CHIP

### Termination of Benefits

All benefits will end the last day of the month following the last day of employment.

## Medical

### UMR Medical Benefits

The City’s medical plan is self-funded. The city engages UMR, a third-party administrator (TPA), to pay the claims and help manage the plan. UMR helps ensure that your claims are paid correctly so that your health care costs can be kept to a minimum and you can focus on well-being.

### United Healthcare Network

The City’s plan utilizes the United Healthcare Choice Plus network. This means that while UMR administers your plan, the doctors, hospitals and other facilities are contracted under the United Healthcare Network. Using an in-network provider will reduce your out-of-pocket costs and protect you from additional expenses that are not covered by the medical plan. Out-of-network providers can charge above the usual and customary amounts for services. Register through the UMR website at www.umr.com to get access to your ID cards, claim details and to find a doctor or hospital.

### Wellness Clinic

The City has partnered with Marathon Health (formerly Everside) to provide a Wellness Clinic to all employees and their dependents who are enrolled in one of the City’s health plans. Services provided at the clinic include wellness exams, chronic disease management, acute care episodes and coordination of care with your primary care provider or specialist. Approximately 50% of the most commonly prescribed medications are available on site. The clinic is available at no or low cost and is staffed by a certified Family Medicine physician.

**What Is Marathon Health?**

Marathon Health is a new way of accessing Primary Care. With Marathon Health, you will have a relationship with your own personal physician that has access to fully equipped clinic locations close to the City of Arvada and all around the Metro Area.

**Who Is Eligible For Marathon Health Membership?**

All employees and their dependents covered by The City of Arvada medical insurance are eligible for membership.

**What Does Membership Entail?**

When you become a member of Marathon Health, you receive a personal physician that is available to you 24/7 as well as access to the full scope of services offered at the clinic locations. Membership is free, and you can use Marathon Health as much or as little as you’d like every month at little or no cost.

**What Types Of Services Do They Offer?**

Our physicians are Board Certified in Family Medicine, allowing them to care for patients from infancy to retirement. Marathon Health serves as your comprehensive health partner, addressing up to 90% of your health and wellness needs, including mental health counseling. We place a strong emphasis on chronic disease management and lifestyle counseling. Additionally, we are fully equipped to handle acute visits, providing services that range from strep tests to basic procedures and prescription management. We offer in-person and virtual care options to meet your needs.

**Can I Maintain a Relationship with My Current PCP?**

Yes, you absolutely can! While we believe that the excellent care, convenience, and affordability at Marathon Health will encourage you to
make a complete switch, there are no obligations to do so.

**What About Specialists?**

You will continue to see specialists in your current network just as today. Your Marathon Health physician will help coordinate referral visits as needed.

**How Do I Sign Up?**

If you enroll in the City’s medical plan, you and your elected family dependents’ profile will be confidentially sent to Marathon Health, allowing you to register by phone call or by downloading the Marathon Health App on your device. The app enables you to conveniently manage appointments, message your physician, view test results, and more!

## Additional Health Resources

### Dispatch Health

Dispatch Health provides in home care 365 days a year and can treat everything an urgent care facility can treats, plus more. Employees and covered dependents on the City’s Health Plan can utilize Dispatch Health’s services in lieu of urgent care. You can get same-day, In-Home Medicare Care for non-life- threatening injuries and illnesses.

### Regenexx

Regenexx is a covered benefit for employees and dependents who are enrolled in the City’s Health Plan. This medical specialty uses regenerative medicine to provide non-surgical relief to treat damaged bone cartilage, muscles, tendons and ligaments through outpatient procedures and often times replaces up to 70% of the need for elective orthopedic surgery.

### Real Appeal

Employees who enroll in the City’s Health Plan are eligible to enroll in Real Appeal, a comprehensive online weight loss program that teaches participants how to take small, manageable steps that lead to a healthier lifestyle. The program is available to eligible members at no additional cost as part of your health benefits. Real Appeal includes up to one year of support from a coach, access to daily dashboard to track progress and weekly & monthly group sessions. Additionally, you receive a free “Success Kit” to help in your journey with scales, a balanced portion plate and access to online fitness content.

### One Pass Select

One Pass Select is designed to help make it easier for employees to prioritize health and wellness through a low-cost, nationwide gym network, digital fitness and grocery delivery service! Choose the option that fits your needs and lifestyle. Employees must elect the City’s UMR Health Plan to access this benefit. Sign up at OnePassSelect.com once you are a member with UMR.

A few of the many advantages:

- No long-term contract or annual gym registration fees
- Flexible fitness options with the ability to change tiers monthly
- Multi-location access with no waiting period
- The ability to add up to four family members or friends (ages 18+) at a 10% monthly discount
- A convenient grocery delivery subscription

## Wellness Incentive

**We support your Health and Wellness with Arvada Wellness!!**

Getting a physical is a great way to stay healthy and save money. You will save up to $520 ($20 per paycheck) on your healthcare premiums in 2027

### You have 2 options to get your Wellness Incentive

1. ### 

   Get your physical with Marathon Health

   - Visit any Marathon Health location to get your physical
   - Marathon Health will send us a monthly list of employees who have completed their physical.

     - No other information will be shared
   - This appointment is covered at little or no cost to you if you are enrolled in City of Arvada health insurance plans
2. Get your physical with your healthcare provider

   - Visit your healthcare provider to get your physical
   - After the exam, ask the provider to give you a note on letterhead or prescription pad stating that you had your annual physical and the date of the physical.

     - The provider’s signature must be on the note.
   - Submit the note to Human Resources at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection) , interoffice mail, or in person.

     - Please do not submit results or any medical information.
   - In most cases, UMR considers physicals a “Wellness Evaluation” and it will be covered at 100% once per calendar year. You do not have to wait 365 days from your previous exam.

     - In some cases, such as additional issues being addressed, the appointment may be subject to a charge.

### Employee can visit Inside Arvada for current rules

Evidence of completion must be provided to Human Resources no later than December 5, 2025.

Email [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection) or contact Human Resources at x7555 if you have questions

## Wellness Packs A Punch!

### Earn a FULL DAY OFF of Wellness Leave Earn a $25 GIFT CARD

In 2026 you have the opportunity to complete TWO Wellness Cards.

- Earn credit for a full day off of Wellness Leave
  - Get 6 credits to earn a full day off, known as “Wellness Leave," based on your regularly scheduled hours
- Earn credits for a $25 gift card
  - Get 6 credits to earn a $25 gift card of your choice to King Soopers, Target, Starbucks, or Lowes (Arvada locations only please)

### Here are a few opportunities to earn punches

- Attend a wellness presentation
- Attend a retirement presentation
- Participate in Bike to Work Day
- Volunteer for at least 4 hours
- Attend a safety sponsored training (such as Stop the Bleed)
- Receive a Safety Recognition Coin issued by COA's Safety Team
- Complete an organized race/walk/activity with proof of completion
  - Examples include a 5k run, charity walk, bike ride, etc....
- Complete a health class and provide proof of completion
  - Examples include fitness, Weight Watchers, Tobacco Cessation, etc....
- Work Out 2x per week over a one month period
  - Please provide documentation such as a print out from your gym, fitness instructor or personal tracking device such as FitBit or MapMyWalk, etc....
- Other opportunities throughout the year, advertised as "Punchworthy"

\*\*Only one punch per activity type per year—this includes training, workouts, running races, gym visits, volunteering and similar activities.

### Rules & Details

- There will be many opportunities to earn punches throughout the year. Information will be emailed out as it becomes available.
- If a physical card is lost, it will be replaced with another and we will not repunch. You may also choose to keep your punches electronically.
- Punches must be earned by October 31, 2025 & the card must be submitted by November 14, 2025.
- Once you have 6 punches, complete the card information and submit to HR via email, interoffice mail, or in person. Be sure to include your first name, last name, and department.
- When completing the blue card, please indicate the store you would like. Please note to use at Arvada locations only. You will be taxed on the gift card on a future paycheck, but the City will cover most of your taxes.
- When you complete the orange card, you will be emailed a certificate for your “Wellness Leave”
  - “Wellness Leave” - Day off must be taken at one time and not split between days.
  - Record the hours in timekeeping as “Wellness Leave”.
  - Wellness leave must be used by December 23, 2026.
  - Wellness leave is “use it or lose it” leave and does not carry over. It may not be used after December 23, 2026. Any unused Wellness Leave will be forfeited.

Email [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection) or contact Human Resources at ext 7555 for questions.

## Dental

### Delta Dental

The City has a self-funded dental plan administered by Delta Dental of Colorado. Participants may use any licensed dentist; however, they are encouraged to use in-network providers to receive the greatest benefit. In-network claims are paid on usual and customary expenses, while out-of-network providers can charge above that. Preventative dental work is paid at 100%. The City pays 80% of the premium; employees pay the remaining 20%. Dental insurance is provided to full and part-time benefited employees who work a minimum of 30 hours per week, on a percentage basis according to the number of hours worked.

#### Delta Dental RIGHT START 4 KIDS (RS4K)

Covers children up to their 13 birthday at 100% with no deductible (for the same services outlined in the plan, up to the annual maximum, and subject to limitations and exclusions). \*If an out-of-network provider is seen, the adult coinsurance levels will apply. Orthodontia services are not eligible for the RS4K 100% coverage level.

## Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)

The City of Arvada offers three Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA’s) through ThrivePass: Health Care, Dependent Care and Limited Purpose (for HSA participants only). To view your FSA balance, submit claims, or add direct deposit information, email ThrivePass online at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection) or download the mobile app. If you contribute to an HSA, you can only use your Health Care Flexible Spending Account for dental and vision care expenses.

### Health Care Flexible Spending Account (HCFSA)

You may contribute up to the IRS maximum pre-tax, per household (per calendar year) for reimbursement of health-related expenses that you may need to pay for out-of-pocket. You have access to your full plan year election amount of Health Care FSA funds immediately. Expenses must be incurred between **January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2026**and submitted for reimbursement by **March 31, 2027**. There is a $660 rollover allowed. Any amount over $660 left in your FSA account will be forfeited. Plan carefully prior to participation in order to avoid forfeitures of contributions. Changes to elections mid- year cannot be made without a Qualified Life Event (QLE). Examples of eligible expenses:

- Copays, Coinsurance, Deductibles
- Hearing aids
- Dental & Orthodontia Expenses
- Chiropractic Care
- Contact Lenses & Eyeglasses
- Over the Counter Medications

You can find a complete list of eligible expenses at: https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/p969.pdf

### Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (DCFSA)

You may contribute up to $5,000 pre-tax (per household, per calendar year) towards out-of-pocket dependent care expenses for children under age 13 and disabled dependents of any age. Expenses may be incurred from **January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2026**as long as you are an active participant in the plan. Dependent care expenses are only reimbursable up to what has been deducted from payroll and deposited to your account. Examples of eligible expenses:

- Licensed day care centers for children & disabled dependents \*
- Costs for family or adult day care facilities \*
- Babysitters outside of your home while you are working \*
- Day camp expenses (but not overnight camps) \*

You can find a complete list of eligible expenses at : https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/p969.pdf

\*Must provide Tax ID# or Social Security Number (SSN)

### Limited Purpose Flexible Spending Account

If you or your spouse is enrolled in a Health Savings Account (HSA), you have the option of electing a Limited Purpose Health Care FSA. Under the Limited Purpose Health Care FSA you can be reimbursed for dental and vision expenses ONLY. You may contribute up to the IRS maximum pre-tax calendar year. Expenses can be incurred from **January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2026**and you are allowed $660 rollover each year.

### Health Savings Account (HSA)

Health Savings Accounts are portable, tax-advantaged savings accounts. Building up a strong HSA is a practical and smart way to invest money that can be used to pay for a wide variety of health & wellness related products & services. An HSA is designed to help offset the deductible costs of the qualifying High Deductible Health Plan.

#### HSA Contribution Limits for 2026

| Coverage Type | Contribution Limit |
| --- | --- |
HSA Contribution Limits for 2026

| Self Only | $4,400 |
| Family | $8,750 |
| Catch Up: Age 55+ | $1,000 |

**Who Can Open An HSA?**

- Any adult (18 or older) can contribute to an HSA if they:
- Have coverage under an HSA qualified “High Deductible Health Plan” (HDHP)
- Have no other first-dollar coverage (Medicare, TRICARE, etc.)
- Cannot be claimed as a dependent on someone else’s tax return

**How Much Can I Contribute?**

If your HSA qualified coverage begins in any month other than January, you can still make the full HSA contribution for the calendar year as long as you keep your HSA qualified coverage through the end of the following calendar year. If you are covered on an HDHP for less than a year, you can contribute 1/12th of the limited amounts for every month you are enrolled in the HSA qualified HDHP.

**What Is The Catch-Up Provision?**

A catch-up provision allows a participant who is older than 55 to contribute up to an additional $1,000 to their account. In the year you enroll in Medicare, you must pro-rate your catch-up contribution for the number of months you had an HSA qualified High Deductible Health Plan
coverage, prior to the month your Medicare enrollment is effective.

#### City Of Arvada HSA Contributions

The City of Arvada will contribute $1,000 for single coverage and $2,000 for all other coverage tiers to supplement your own contributions as you work to make the account grow. Employer and applicable employee contributions will be made on a bi-weekly basis. Once you have enrolled in the HDHP, your eligibility information will be automatically sent to HSA Bank by UMR to open your HSA account. If you are a new hire and elect the HDHP mid-year, contributions are pro-rated.

**HSA Advantages**

**Security:** Your HDHP Plan protects your financial future from catastrophic medical events.

**Affordability**: HSA qualified HDHP Plans cost less, enabling you to purchase lower cost medical insurance coverage.

**Portability:**Accounts belong to the account holder. You can keep your HSA if you move to another state or if you change jobs, medical coverage, or marital status.

**Ownership:**Funds remain in the account year-to-year. There are no “use it or lose it” rules for HSAs.

**Tax Savings:** HSAs Provide Triple Tax Savings

1. Tax deductions when you contribute to your account
2. Tax free earnings on funds maintained in the account
3. Tax free withdrawals for qualified medical expenses

## Life & Disability Insurance

The City provides employees with basic life insurance through That Hartford Life Insurance Company.

Both Civilian employees and Sworn Police personnel are covered for basic life insurance AND accidental death and dismemberment insurance of 2x their annual salary to a maximum of $500,000.

### Prudential / FPPA Long-Term Disability

Civilian employees have Long Term Disability (LTD) insurance coverage through the Prudential Insurance Company.

Sworn personnel have LTD insurance though the Fire & Police Pension Association (FPPA) as well as Prudential when eligible. Coverage is below:

#### Long-term Disability Benefit Amounts

Prudential / FFPA Long-term Disability

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| LTD Benefit Amount | 60% of monthly salary |
| LTD Maximum Benefit | $10,000 |
| LTD Waiting Period | 90 days |
| LTD Benefit Duration | Social Security Normal Retirement |

### Voluntary Life & AD&D Insurance

The Hartford Life Insurance Company offers group voluntary term insurance to all employees, subject to underwriting approval. If applied for within 30 days of eligibility, there is a guarantee issue amount of $100,000 for the employee and $30,000 for a spouse.

This plan allows employee and spouse a choice of coverage in amounts of $10,000 to $500,000 up to a maximum of 6x the employee’s annual salary at the time of application. Employee and spouse premiums are determined by age and tobacco use. Children’s coverage is available in the amount of $5,000 or $10,000.

The plan is portable, meaning an employee can continue coverage at modified group rates should they leave City of Arvada employment.

A voluntary Accidental Death & Dismemberment plan is also available to all employees and their families. The maximum amount of coverage is $300,000.

### Long-Term Care Insurance

Voluntary Long-Term Care insurance is available through Unum Life Insurance Company of America. This coverage helps pay for nursing home, assisted living, or in- home care when a participant is unable to perform at least three activities of daily living such as eating, bathing, toileting, etc.

Four different plans are available and employees may purchase benefits of up to $9,000 per month, for a duration of 3 years, 6 years, or lifetime.

Rates are are age-based, but are locked in once the applicant is approved and the rate does not increase with age.

New hires within 30 days of eligibility are eligible for a guarantee issue of up to $6,000 per month, for a maxim of 6 years. This plan is portable and may be continued at the same group rates when employment is terminated.

## Personalized Benefits

### Aflac

Aflac is different from health insurance, which pays doctors and hospitals. Aflac pays cash benefits directly to the participant to help with daily expenses when you’re sick or injured. These plans are guaranteed issue to new hires within their first 30 days of eligibility, meaning that coverage is guaranteed even if you have a pre-existing medical condition. If coverage is not elected in the first 30 days of eligibility, enrollment is available during the annual open enrollment period.

### Accident Insurance

An Aflac Accident policy helps participants cope with out-of-pocket medical expenses that add up quickly after an injury. Whether you have a minor or major accident, you are issued a lump-sum amount based on your policy to help cover expenses such as coinsurance, travel expenses, copays, etc. Covered members and dependents are also eligible for an annual wellness benefit of $50. You can receive the $50 wellness benefit in a number of ways such as getting your annual physical, flu shot, or eye exam.

### Critical Illness Insurance

The Aflac Critical Illness policy allows policy holders to concentrate on healing. Participants who are diagnosed with a critical illness such as cancer, heart attack, stroke, or several other illnesses may be eligible for a cash benefit based on their policy. It also includes an annual wellness benefit of $50 for the covered member and spouse.

## Retirement & Valuable Extras

### Retirement Plans

Civilian employees participate in the City of Arvada Retirement Plan (CARP). Employees contribute 8% of salary; the City contributes 10%. This is a 401a defined contribution plan and is a replacement for Social Security.

Police Officers participate in the Police Money Purchase Plan (PMPP). Sworn offices contribute 12% of salary; the City contributes 12%. This is a 401a defined contribution plan and is a replacement for Social Security.

All employees are eligible to participate in a 457 Deferred Compensation Program, with both Traditional and Roth options available. Sworn Police Personnel are eligible participate in a 457 Deferred Compensation Program with both Traditional and Roth options available. This is offered through the Fire and Police Pension Association (FPPA).

### Employee Assistance Program

When life presents challenges of any kind, you have an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) available to you 24 hours/day to provide expert support. The EAP, contracted through ComPsych, provides confidential services and resources to you and your family to assist with life’s unexpected events.

Assistance is available in a variety of areas including marital & family problems, stress issues, anxiety & depression, chemical dependency, grief & loss, and financial difficulties. Up to five sessions per person/per issue/per year are available. This is a free and confidential service to employees and their dependents, including 24 hour Emergency Service.

**Confidentiality: Use of these services is completely confidential. Your employer is not given personal information about who has used the service without written consent, except where required by law.**

**On the Phone:**Call 800.272.7255  
Counselors are available 24/7, 365 days/year through the toll-free number for assessment and consultations. You will have access to initial telephone assessment of concerns, references to resources, and in-person providers when needed.

**Face-to-Face:**Five (5) counseling sessions per occurrence per year.

**Online:** Guidance Resources Online is an award-winning comprehensive and interactive service available to provide trusted, expert information, resources, referrals and answers to everyday questions at your convenience.

## More Valuable Extras

### Tuition Reimbursement

Up to $2,000 of Tuition Reimbursement per employee per calendar year is available for job related classes taken at an accredited college or university. Reach out to Human Resources for more information.

### Employee Training & Development

The Organization & Development department hosts a variety of mandatory & optional training opportunities for employees. Topics include career development, ethics, leadership skills, and more. Available training courses are routinely advertised through email. Career Progression & Professional Development opportunities (including some training and certifications) may also be available through your department. Check with your supervisor for specific details.

### Uniforms, Safety Shoes & Glasses

Rental and laundry service of uniforms is provided for certain positions. Safety Shoes and other necessary equipment are provided to employees in safety-sensitive positions. Check with your supervisor or the City’s Risk Department to see if you qualify.

### Direct Deposit of Payroll

Employees are paid every other Friday via mandatory direct deposit. Pay stubs are distributed to employees electronically. Many local banks and credit unions offer special incentives to City employees - be sure to mention you are an employee of The City of Arvada to your banking representative.

**Medicare Deductions:**

- Required by the Federal Government, the deduction is 1.45% of pay.
- An additional Medicare Tax of 0.9% is deducted on individual wages in excess of $200,000 in a calendar year.

### Other Employee Discounts

City Hall and several other outlying facilities maintain small fitness centers & equipment for the free use of employees.

Employees of the City of Arvada receive discounts on Apex Center Individual & Family Annual Passes

- 10% off of the Resident Rate when choosing to pay on a month-by-month basis
- 15% off of the Resident Rate when choosing to pay in full at the time of purchase

The Arvada Center offers discounts on classes and performances to employees. Watch for emails or contact The Arvada Center directly for more information.

## Time Off

### Paid Leave

Part-Time benefited employees who work a minimum of 30 hours per week accrue vacation, holiday, floating holiday, and sick leave on a percentage basis, deter
